messages:
jess: Heads-up — prototype idea: an 'autopause' for feature flags. If telemetry shows a clear regression (errors/latency), flip flag to a safe variant automatically. Want quick feedback on obvious failure modes and config shape.
marco: Love the idea. Quick q: what signals are we trusting? error-rate vs latency vs quality?
jess: Proposal draft: two-tier triggers. 1) error_rate > 0.5% (3m rolling) OR 2) p95 latency > 2s for 5m. Also require minimum volume: >= 1000 requests in window to avoid noise.
anju: Small services will never hit 1000 though. Suggest fallback: (min_count >= 50) AND relative change >= 3x baseline. Also need cooldown/backoff so we don't flip-flop.
marco: Agreed. Also prefer graded decay instead of immediate 100% revert. e.g., reduce exposure from 100% -> 50% -> 10% -> 0 over N minutes.
jess: Canary-decay is a good default. Ops playbook must include manual override and an audit trail. devex: can the console show "autopaused by rule <id>" with link to alert & RFC?
devex: We can. Add a flag state + reason field and a clickable alert link. Also we should surface who owns the autopause rule.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled job 'autopause-watch' deployed to staging @ 1769999996 :rocket:
anju: Another major edge-case: quality regressions (LLM hallucination) won't bump latency/errors. We'll need eval-based signals from Optimize or a custom eval harness.
jess: Yup — design will accept pluggable signal hooks. Prototype uses latency/errors to move fast, but we'll wire eval checks soon.
marco: If this fires for an LLM route, fallback routing options: route to smaller compatible model variant, or route to deterministic rules. Need policy per-flag: action = {pause | route_to:MODEL | decay_weights}.
jess: Exactly. Default action could be route_to:last-stable-variant. We also need TTL on autopause and auto-unpause logic: auto-unpause after X hours with a dry-run for 10% traffic to validate.
anju: +1 for dry-run. Also log all autopause decisions to the telemetry ledger and expose them in the rollout dashboard.
jess: I'll sketch an RFC and a config schema: fields = [signal_rules, min_volume, decay_steps, action, ttl, cooldown, owners, audit_link]. Who wants to review?
marco: I will — ping me when RFC is up.
devex: I'll mock the console state and sample copy for the ops playbook.
ops-bot: incident-bot: created test pager "autopause-firing-test" in staging (no real pages)
jess: Thanks all. I'll drop a short RFC + YAML example and a minimal config UI mock in #eng-platform when ready. :thumbsup:
